name: Piercing Sound
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

Each round, you can target a single living creature, striking it with a piercing sound. Depending on the target’s HD, this attack has as many as three effects.

The effects are cumulative and concurrent.

Deafened: The sound washes over the target. A creature affected by this spell remains deafened for 10 minutes per caster level. The effects cannot be negated by a remove blindness/deafness or heal spell, but a remove curse is effective.
Nauseated: The subject becomes nauseated for 1d4 rounds. Even after the nausea ends, the creature remains sickened for 10 minutes per caster level, and it automatically becomes nauseated again if it comes within earshot of you during that time.
Dazed: The subject is dazed by the sound for 10 minutes per caster level.

You must spend a swift action each round after the first to target a foe.
